propositions: Recovery operation must be invoked exactly once at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary, after staleness gate and before first remote fetch
Read-only and filtered reconciliation paths must perform zero writes from the recovery operation
The repair must occur before remote observation to prevent interleaving fresh liveness evidence with retirement completion
Completion failure must preserve overlap state for retry and structurally cannot trigger remote calls due to pre-fetch positioning
Durable tombstones remain authoritative against automatic confirmations and absence resets until explicitly removed by unretire
The invocation site is reconcile.py (not run_differs.py) within a four-line budget constraint with guard logic owned by binding_recovery.repair_at_write_boundary
